Column: 1720

MEDISAVE BALANCES OF CPF MEMBERS

(Breakdown)

     15.  Mdm Halimah Yacob asked the Minister for Health (a) if he will provide a breakdown of the Medisave balances of CPF members by age and income level; (b) how many CPF members have accumulated the Medisave Minimum Sum; and (c) how many CPF members have no Medisave savings at all.

     Mr Khaw Boon Wan:  Sir, a breakdown of the Medisave balances of CPF members by age and income level is tabulated on Ministry of Health's website.  The Clerk of Parliament will now circulate the statistical table to Members, as it will be time-consuming for me to read out those data.  [Copies of table distributed to Members.]

 

               Table: Average Medisave Balances of CPF Members (as at December 2006)

 

     As expected, the average Medisave balance would increase with income level.  Likewise, it would also increase with the age of the members, but up to the age of 60.
